ui_configuration: Select both Data Tables in every matching Data Table node. Task-state insert/update are only in CAS — Persist Task State; Orchestrator keeps Load task by ID.

Bind Activity — Hydrate Data Table nodes, activate the webhook, set ACTIVITY_HYDRATE_URL on mas-activity if it is not derived from N8N_BASE_URL (Compose default http://n8n:5678/webhook/mas-activity-hydrate).
Apply all mandatory Execute Workflow bindings (CAS persist fan-in, Entry, Human Gate, Health Check, Orchestrator specialists) — see docs.md Step 4.

Set Settings → Error workflow to Error — MAS Case Handler on runtime workflows (not on the handler itself, nor CAS Persist / Trace Writer). Uncaught node crashes then enter Error Trigger; classified domain errors still use the Orchestrator Execute Workflow branch.
Create Data Tables from docs.md or n8n/data-tables/*.header.csv, then bind every Data Table node listed in Step 3.
Run Form — MAS Deployment Health Check before activating user forms; fix every FAIL using where_to_fix.
Activate Form — MAS Entry for new tasks and Form — MAS Human Gate for transparent HITL resume; engineers answer questions in the form without copying expected_version/gate_id.
Configure Excel Tools base URL/API key; 127.0.0.1 is valid only when n8n runs on the same Windows host.
Edit Math Service Configuration in Agent — Calculation (Math Service); its default is http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/v1/math and it uses no credential.
Configure one embedding model/dimension consistently for MAS — Knowledge Ingestion and MAS — Knowledge Retrieval.

Use MAS — Knowledge Ingestion to load expert-authored keyword_instruction and worked_example text into target_base=schedule_mvp; include schema_catalogue JSON only when deterministic rendering needs it.

Seed the MAS corpus via Activity Knowledge → Загрузить в RAG (live excel-agent-operating-guide.documents.json) or MAS — Knowledge Ingestion Manual trigger (Packaged MAS corpus snapshot). Existing target_base+knowledge_id+revision rows are skipped. Empty tag filters never match the whole namespace.
Keep every workflow inactive until placeholders and credentials are resolved. Activate only required user-facing entrypoints.
activation_order: Run MAS — Knowledge Ingestion (Activity Knowledge → Загрузить в RAG, or Manual trigger Sync packaged MAS knowledge) and verify through MAS — Knowledge Retrieval.
Smoke-test Excel Agent and the inline .data/.inc path while inactive.
Smoke-test Universal Orchestrator through Execute Workflow, then Form, then authenticated HTTP.
Activate Universal Orchestrator web entrypoints only after all gates pass.
